owner_instruction: Use Soldier Blue as the ninth secret role: a Blue team player with one shot in the game, like Undercover.
supersedes: rules/overlays/officer-public-office-owner-decision-2026-10-25.json: STARTING-WEAPON and the unresolved nine-player setup follow-up

role.name: Soldier Blue
role.shot_rules: Use the same ordinary-shot timing, own-turn, same-location targeting, damage, shooter eligibility and defensive interactions as Undercover. The shot deals one damage. No early-round shooting privilege.
role.starting_information: No special starting identities or Code information.
role.other_abilities: No Undercover Protection or permission to lie in Hack is copied. Officer remains a separate public office appointed by Captain.
role.supplier_interaction: Existing role-independent Supplier targeting remains. An additional weapon does not increase Soldier Blue's one ordinary shot per match.
role.showdown: The existing final-showdown special shot is separate from this ordinary-shot allowance.

unchanged: Seven- and eight-player setups and the public Captain/Officer design are unchanged. Do not restore the former Blue Officer secret role.
implementation_boundary: Confirmed design for GameN Design Studio. A reviewed gameplay successor is still needed; existing engine tuples and active match histories are not rewritten.
